verses.original: Τὸ λοιπόν μου ἀδελφοί χαίρετε ἐν Κυρίῳ οὐκ ὀκνηρόν ἐμοὶ γράφειν τὰ αὐτὰ ὑμῖν μὲν δὲ ἀσφαλές ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: To loipon mou adelphoi chairete en Kyriō ouk oknēron emoi graphein ta auta hymin men de asphales hymin
verses.literal: - Finally my brothers rejoice in [the] Lord [It is] no trouble for me to write the same things to you again and [it is] a safeguard for you

verses.original: Βλέπετε τοὺς κύνας βλέπετε τοὺς ἐργάτας κακοὺς βλέπετε τὴν κατατομήν
verses.transliteration: Blepete tous kynas blepete tous ergatas kakous blepete tēn katatomēn
verses.literal: Watch out for those dogs - those workers of evil - those mutilators of the flesh

verses.original: γάρ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν ἡ περιτομή οἱ λατρεύοντες Πνεύματι Θεοῦ καὶ καυχώμενοι ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ οὐκ πεποιθότες ἐν σαρκὶ
verses.transliteration: gar hēmeis esmen hē peritomē hoi latreuontes Pneumati Theou kai kauchōmenoi en Christō Iēsou kai ouk pepoithotes en sarki
verses.literal: For [it is] we [who] are the circumcision we who worship by [the] Spirit of God who glory in Christ Jesus and [who] vvv put no confidence in [the] flesh

verses.original: καίπερ ἐγὼ καὶ ἔχων πεποίθησιν ἐν σαρκί Εἴ τις ἄλλος δοκεῖ πεποιθέναι ἐν σαρκί ἐγὼ μᾶλλον
verses.transliteration: kaiper egō kai echōn pepoithēsin en sarki Ei tis allos dokei pepoithenai en sarki egō mallon
verses.literal: though I myself . . . could have such confidence . . . . . . If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in [the] flesh I [have] more

verses.original: περιτομῇ ὀκταήμερος ἐκ γένους Ἰσραήλ φυλῆς Βενιαμίν Ἑβραῖος ἐξ Ἑβραίων κατὰ νόμον Φαρισαῖος
verses.transliteration: peritomē oktaēmeros ek genous Israēl phylēs Beniamin Hebraios ex Hebraiōn kata nomon Pharisaios
verses.literal: circumcised on [the] eighth day of [the] people of Israel of [the] tribe of Benjamin a Hebrew of Hebrews as to [the] law a Pharisee

verses.original: κατὰ ζῆλος διώκων τὴν ἐκκλησίαν κατὰ δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐν νόμῳ γενόμενος ἄμεμπτος
verses.transliteration: kata zēlos diōkōn tēn ekklēsian kata dikaiosynēn tēn en nomō genomenos amemptos
verses.literal: as to zeal persecuting the church as to righteousness - in [the] law - faultless

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἅτινα ἦν κέρδη μοι ταῦτα ἥγημαι ζημίαν διὰ τὸν Χριστὸν
verses.transliteration: Alla hatina ēn kerdē moi tauta hēgēmai zēmian dia ton Christon
verses.literal: But whatever was gain to me - I count as loss for the sake of - Christ

verses.original: ἀλλὰ μὲν‿ οὖν‿ γε καὶ ἡγοῦμαι πάντα εἶναι ζημίαν διὰ τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ μου τοῦ Κυρίου δι’ ὃν ἐζημιώθην τὰ πάντα καὶ ἡγοῦμαι σκύβαλα ἵνα κερδήσω Χριστὸν
verses.transliteration: alla men oun ge kai hēgoumai panta einai zēmian dia to hyperechon tēs gnōseōs Christou Iēsou mou tou Kyriou di’ hon ezēmiōthēn ta panta kai hēgoumai skybala hina kerdēsō Christon
verses.literal: More than that . . . . . . . . . . . . I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my - Lord for whom I have lost - all things - I consider [them] rubbish that I may gain Christ

verses.original: καὶ εὑρεθῶ ἐν αὐτῷ μὴ ἔχων ἐμὴν δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐκ νόμου ἀλλὰ τὴν διὰ πίστεως Χριστοῦ τὴν δικαιοσύνην ἐκ Θεοῦ ἐπὶ τῇ πίστει
verses.transliteration: kai heurethō en autō mē echōn emēn dikaiosynēn tēn ek nomou alla tēn dia pisteōs Christou tēn dikaiosynēn ek Theou epi tē pistei
verses.literal: and be found in Him not having my own righteousness - from [the] law but that which [is] through faith in Christ the righteousness from God on the basis of - faith

verses.original: τοῦ γνῶναι αὐτὸν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν τῆς αὐτοῦ ἀναστάσεως καὶ τὴν κοινωνίαν τῶν αὐτοῦ παθημάτων συμμορφιζόμενος τῷ αὐτοῦ θανάτῳ
verses.transliteration: tou gnōnai auton kai tēn dynamin tēs autou anastaseōs kai tēn koinōnian tōn autou pathēmatōn symmorphizomenos tō autou thanatō
verses.literal: - [I want] to know [Christ] and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings being conformed to [Him] in His death

verses.original: εἴ πως καταντήσω εἰς τὴν ἐξανάστασιν τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: ei pōs katantēsō eis tēn exanastasin tēn ek nekrōn
verses.literal: and so somehow to attain to the resurrection - from [the] dead

verses.original: Οὐχ ὅτι ἤδη ἔλαβον ἢ ἤδη τετελείωμαι δὲ διώκω εἰ καὶ καταλάβω ἐφ’ ᾧ ὑπὸ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ κατελήμφθην
verses.transliteration: Ouch hoti ēdē elabon ē ēdē teteleiōmai de diōkō ei kai katalabō eph’ hō hypo Christou Iēsou kai katelēmphthēn
verses.literal: Not that vvv I have already obtained [all this] or vvv have already been made perfect but I press on - - to take hold of that for which . . . - Christ Jesus - took hold of me

verses.original: ἀδελφοί ἐγὼ οὐ λογίζομαι ἐμαυτὸν κατειληφέναι δέ ἓν μὲν ἐπιλανθανόμενος τὰ ὀπίσω δὲ ἐπεκτεινόμενος τοῖς ἔμπροσθεν
verses.transliteration: adelphoi egō ou logizomai emauton kateilēphenai de hen men epilanthanomenos ta opisō de epekteinomenos tois emprosthen
verses.literal: Brothers I {do} not consider myself yet to have taken hold [of it] But one thing [I do] - Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what [is] ahead

verses.original: διώκω κατὰ σκοπὸν εἰς τὸ βραβεῖον τῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἄνω κλήσεως ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: diōkō kata skopon eis to brabeion tēs tou Theou anō klēseōs en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: I press on toward [the] goal to [win] the prize of - God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus

verses.original: οὖν Ὅσοι τέλειοι τοῦτο φρονῶμεν καὶ εἴ φρονεῖτε ἑτέρως τι ὁ Θεὸς ἀποκαλύψει τοῦτο ὑμῖν καὶ
verses.transliteration: oun Hosoi teleioi touto phronōmen kai ei phroneite heterōs ti ho Theos apokalypsei touto hymin kai
verses.literal: - All of us who [are] mature vvv should embrace this point of view And if you think differently about some issue - God will reveal this to you as well

verses.original: πλὴν στοιχεῖν τῷ αὐτῷ εἰς ὃ ἐφθάσαμεν
verses.transliteration: plēn stoichein tō autō eis ho ephthasamen
verses.literal: Nevertheless we must live up . . . . . . to what we have already attained

verses.original: Συμμιμηταί γίνεσθε μου ἀδελφοί καὶ σκοπεῖτε τοὺς οὕτω περιπατοῦντας καθὼς τύπον ἔχετε ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Symmimētai ginesthe mou adelphoi kai skopeite tous houtō peripatountas kathōs typon echete hēmas
verses.literal: Join one another in following . . . my [example] brothers and carefully observe those who - walk according to the pattern we set for you . . .

verses.original: γὰρ οὓς ἔλεγον πολλάκις ὑμῖν δὲ νῦν λέγω καὶ κλαίων πολλοὶ περιπατοῦσιν τοὺς ἐχθροὺς τοῦ σταυροῦ τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar hous elegon pollakis hymin de nyn legō kai klaiōn polloi peripatousin tous echthrous tou staurou tou Christou
verses.literal: For [as] I have often told . . . you {before} and now say [again] even with tears Many live - [as] enemies of the cross - of Christ

verses.original: ὧν τὸ τέλος ἀπώλεια ὧν ὁ θεὸς ἡ κοιλία καὶ ἡ δόξα ἐν αὐτῶν τῇ αἰσχύνῃ οἱ φρονοῦντες ἐπίγεια τὰ
verses.transliteration: hōn to telos apōleia hōn ho theos hē koilia kai hē doxa en autōn tē aischynē hoi phronountes epigeia ta
verses.literal: [Their] - end [is] destruction [their] - god [is] [their] belly and [their] glory [is] in their - shame Their minds are set on earthly things

verses.original: γὰρ Ἡμῶν τὸ πολίτευμα ὑπάρχει ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἀπεκδεχόμεθα Σωτῆρα ἐξ οὗ Κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: gar Hēmōn to politeuma hyparchei en ouranois kai apekdechometha Sōtēra ex hou Kyrion Iēsoun Christon
verses.literal: But our - citizenship is in heaven and we eagerly await a Savior from [there] [the] Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: ὃς κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν αὐτὸν τοῦ δύνασθαι καὶ ὑποτάξαι τὰ πάντα αὑτῷ μετασχηματίσει ἡμῶν τῆς ταπεινώσεως τὸ σῶμα σύμμορφον τῷ αὐτοῦ τῆς δόξης σώματι
verses.transliteration: hos kata tēn energeian auton tou dynasthai kai hypotaxai ta panta hautō metaschēmatisei hēmōn tēs tapeinōseōs to sōma symmorphon tō autou tēs doxēs sōmati
verses.literal: who by the power vvv vvv that enables Him . . . to subject - all things to Himself will transform our - lowly - bodies to be like - His - glorious body
